scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace desktop/renderer"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace desktop/renderer" "cross-env RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run start --prefix desktop"
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build --workspace desktop/renderer && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace desktop/renderer && npm run build --workspace server
